title: Bennewitz involuntarily committed
summary: John Brandenburg tells of Bennewitz involuntarily committed, about 1980s at New Mexico (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
plain: A physicist named John Brandenburg told podcast host Jesse Michels about Paul Bennewitz, a man in New Mexico in the 1980s who became caught up in UFO matters. Brandenburg says that Bennewitz was committed to a psychiatric hospital against his will. If true, it shows how heavy the cost of that involvement became for him.
